Microsoft's XAML framework (WinUI), vendored for NovaOS
=======================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml (MIT, LICENSE),
commit 866ba81a1c7c644e41fb838c755273e8f73e3a74 (2026-10-15).
Kept so far, unchanged: dxaml/xcp/dxaml/idl (the framework's API in MIDL 3
IDL: winrt/ its Windows Runtime types, com/ its classic COM interop
interfaces), dxaml/xcp/inc/FeatureFlags.h (which IDL features are on),
dxaml/xcp/components/xamlDiagnostics/idl (XAML diagnostics' IDL), and the
sources roadmap step 32.3 builds so far with the headers they include: the
XAML core's lowest component libraries (dxaml/xcp/components: base,
xstring, criticalsection, dependencyLocator, runtimeEnabledFeatures, com,
threading, staticpal, qualifiers; the type metadata, metadata and
metadata/DynamicMetadataStorage;
CDependencyObject's property system, DependencyObject and its minimal
DependencyObject/minlib; the value types CValue, flyweight,
primitiveDependencyObjects, math and theming; the collections, Collection;
with their MSBuild projects; the resources, deferral, legacy, colors and
winuri components and the markup parser, core/Parser, with the .props
files its sources.props imports; the parser's object writer runtime,
core/Parser/runtime, and the core's resource dictionary,
core/core/elements' Resources.cpp with the other sources of
elements.except.vcxproj and its sources.props, and DeferredKeys.cpp; the
simple properties and name scopes, components/simple and
components/namescope), pal/common's ctypes.cpp and matrix.cpp (the
math library's geometry helpers) and MemoryStream, MemoryStreamBuffer,
refcounting, MsResourceHelpers and UriXStringGetters (the parser's and
WinURI's), core/dll/services.cpp, the isolated unit tests' stubs and
metadata mocks (components/unittests/stubs, less seven stubs NovaOS does
not link, and components/metadata/mocks; xaml_teststubs.lib, linked by
xamlbasetest), the isolated parser unit tests' mock core services
(components/parser/unittests, linked by xamlparsetest, with
dxaml/test/native/inc/XamlLogging.h), the components'
precompiled header (components/pch), headers from dxaml/xcp/inc, core/inc,
pal and the components' inc directories those include, the core services
(core/dll/xcpcore.cpp and xcpcore_namescope.cpp, with core/xcpcore.vcxproj,
core/hw's MaxTextureSizeProvider.cpp and AtlasRequestProvider.cpp, and the
headers they include), what CCoreServices::Create makes (core/dll's
rendertargetbitmapmgr.cpp, core/dethunk/elements/MediaQueue.cpp,
core/text/common/TextCore.cpp, core/native/text/Common/WinTextCore.cpp with
its project and precompiled header, core/core/elements/geometry.cpp with
the elements' lib/elements.vcxproj, components/theminginterop), the
platform layer (plat/win/browserdesktop's xcpwin.cpp, PlatformServices.cpp,
WinThreadPool.cpp and early_init.cpp, with its project, sources.props and
precompiled header), the framework's entry points (dxaml/lib's
DXamlCore.cpp, DXamlInstanceStorage.cpp, DXamlServices.cpp,
comTemplateLibrary.cpp, XamlReader.cpp and FrameworkApplication_Partial.cpp,
winrtgeneratedclasses' XamlReader.g.cpp and FrameworkApplication.g.cpp, with
lib/sources.props, lib/precomp.h and winrtfoundation/wrtdxamlfoundation.vcxproj,
then ErrorHelper.cpp and JupiterControl.cpp, then dispatcher.cpp,
DefaultStyles.cpp, Window_Partial.cpp with winrtgeneratedclasses'
Window.g.cpp, and DependencyObject.cpp), the control layer
(control/common/shared's ControlBase.cpp and FrameCounter.cpp with sl/controlBase.vcxproj,
sl/sources.g.props, sources.props and precomp.h; win/shared's xcpwindow.cpp
and PendingMessages.cpp with sl/shared.vcxproj, sources.props and precomp.h;
host/win/browserdesktop/WinBrowserHost.cpp with hostpalplatmisc.vcxproj and
the top-level precomp.h), the rendering seam under the browser host
(core/compositor's compositorscheduler.cpp, UIThreadScheduler.cpp,
windowrendertarget.cpp, RefreshRateInfo.cpp, RefreshAlignedClock.cpp and
hardwarecommand.cpp; core/hw's CompositorTreeHost.cpp, hwwalk.cpp,
hwtexturemgr.cpp and hwsurfacecache.cpp with hw.vcxproj and precomp.h;
core/common/values.cpp; core/error/ErrorService.cpp; plat/win/desktop's
windowsgraphicsdevicemanager.cpp, d3d11device.cpp, D3D11DeviceInstance.cpp
and D2DAccelerated.cpp with platwindesktop.vcxproj, but not its precomp.h,
which names closed headers; components/graphics' WindowsGraphicsDeviceManager.cpp,
ProjectedShadowManager.cpp and Scheduler.cpp, components/comptree's
DCompTreeHost.cpp and OfferTracker.cpp and components/brushes'
WUCBrushManager.cpp, with their lib projects; control/download with its
project and precomp.hpp; control/common/shared/AsyncDownloadRequestManager.cpp,
win/shared/UIAHostEnvironmentInfo.cpp and
host/win/browserdesktop/windwnreq.cpp),
the value boxer (components/valueboxer's lib, with its project) and the
lifetime library (components/lifetime's lib, with its project), dxaml/lib's
StaticStore.cpp and UIAffinityReleaseQueue.cpp, the core's error event
args (core/error/ErrorEventArgs.cpp), deployment
(core/packaging/deployment.cpp) and entry points (core/dll/CoreImports.cpp)
and, for XamlReader.Load end to end (32.3), the element classes
(core/core/elements and elements2, less the ones that need closed headers:
svgimagesource, glyphs, imagebrush, swapchainpanel, deferredkeys,
softwarebitmapsource, xamlislandroot; popup joined with the
Application.Start part), the text core's TextBlock
subset (core/text: TextBlock, inlines, runs, inherited properties and
common/text.cpp), the type table (core/metadata/dynamic), the core's event
manager (core/dll/eventmgr.cpp), components/elements (CUIElement and
CFrameworkElement) with its lib project, components/Telemetry's
GCInstrumentationAggregator.cpp with its project, components/graphics'
AlphaMask.cpp, ExpressionHelper.cpp, XamlLightTargetIdMap.cpp and
XamlLightTargetMap.cpp, and dxaml/lib's framework peers for UIElement,
FrameworkElement, Panel, Grid, TextBlock, Control, ContentControl,
ButtonBase, Button, Border, ContentPresenter, ResourceDictionary, Style,
Setter, the templates, the event args and ExternalObjectReference (their
_Partial.cpp and winrtgeneratedclasses' .g.cpp), with UWPWindowImpl.cpp,
ContentManager.cpp, DXamlCoreLightup.cpp, FxCallbacks.cpp,
XamlParserCallbacks.cpp, UtilityFunctions.cpp, JoltClasses.cpp,
ActivationAPI.cpp and DirectUIXamlQualifiedObject.cpp,
and, for Application.Start's desktop path (32.3, the end of it),
dxaml/lib's WindowsXamlManager_Partial.cpp, DebugSettings_Partial.cpp and
ErrorInfo.cpp with the generated classes of WindowsXamlManager,
DebugSettings, ApplicationInitializationCallbackParams,
LaunchActivatedEventArgs and XamlShutdownCompletedOnThreadEventArgs, the
core's application (core/packaging/application.cpp), visual tree
(core/dll/VisualTree.cpp), focus manager (core/dll/focusmgr.cpp), time
manager (core/animation/timemgr.cpp), layout manager (core/layout) and
input services (core/input: InputServices.cpp,
DirectManipulationServiceSharedState.cpp, RoutedEventArgs.cpp and the
focus event args), dxaml/lib's JupiterWindow.cpp and the generated
XamlIslandRootCollection, control/common/shared/ResourceManager.cpp, and
components/ContentRoot, components/focus (FocusObserver, FocusProperties,
FocusSelection, Movement, XYFocus), components/scaling and
components/AccessKeys (Export, AccessKey, ModeContainer, Parser) with
their projects,
and the headers those include, external/inc's gsl
and ankerl, and XAML's ETW manifest
(dxaml/xcp/plat/win/desktop/Microsoft-Windows-XAML-ETW.man).  The rest of
dxaml (the rest of the core and the controls) joins as
the build takes it in (docs/design/windows-ui-xaml.md).

tools/winrt/abigen.py turns the IDL into the C++ ABI headers MIDL would
make (MIDL is not used).  Features FeatureFlags.h marks AlwaysDisabled are
left out, as MIDL leaves them out of the public metadata; Feature_HeaderPlacement
is left out too, so the result matches the published Microsoft.UI.Xaml.winmd.

To update: copy the same files from a newer commit, run
python3 tools/winrt/abigen.py --check, and build (userland/windows_ui_xaml/
build.py compiles the components; a source a newer commit adds to their
projects, or a header it newly includes, has to be copied too).
